name: THE BRICK ROASTERY AND COFFEE BEAN

violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Observed shelving in the storage area that was not sealed. This needs to be a smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Food product found under hand wash sink
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Boxes found on floor of storage area
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. -At time of inspection coffee pot was in hand washing sink
